title: Configuration Guide for appendMCP

Note: multi-armed studies, analysis can triggered monitoring subset treatment arms sample_size: Target sample size binary endpoints (NA time--event) events: Target number events time--event endpoints (NA binary) power_subsets_any: Named list hypothesis subsets “least one rejection” power calculations. element vector hypothesis indices (e.g., list("H1, H2" = c(1, 2)) means power reject least one H1 H2) power_subsets_all: Named list hypothesis subsets “rejections” power calculations. element vector hypothesis indices (e.g., list("H1, H2, H3" = c(1, 2, 3)) means power reject H1, H2, H3)

title: Configuration Guide for appendMCP
text: hypotheses data frame specifies statistical hypotheses tested. display columns parts: Hypotheses - Part 1: Basic Definition Hypotheses - Part 2: Analysis Assignments Hypotheses - Part 3: Spending Functions Hypotheses - Part 4: Test Methods Column Definitions: type: Hypothesis type (“Primary” “Secondary”) endpoint: Endpoint tested strata: List strata hypothesis control: Control treatment arm name test: Test treatment arm name analyses_analysed: List single value specifying analyses (row index analyses data frame) test hypothesis sf: Spending function type (“none”, “asHSD”, “asOF”, “asP”, “asKD”, “asUser”) group sequential design sfpar: Spending function parameter (e.g., gamma HSD; NULL applicable) nominal: Nominal alpha spending interim analyses (optional; NULL specified) test_method: Statistical test method (“logrank”, “stratified_logrank”, “unpooled_proportions”, “pooled_proportions”, “cmh”) Spending Function Types: - "none": group sequential testing (single analysis) - "asHSD": Hwang-Shih-DeCani spending function - "asOF": O’Brien-Fleming spending function - "asP": Pocock spending function - "asKD": Kim-DeMets spending function - "asUser": User-defined spending Test Method Types: - "logrank": Log-rank test time--event endpoints (unstratified) - "stratified_logrank": Stratified log-rank test time--event endpoints - "unpooled_proportions": Two-sample test proportions (unpooled variance) - "pooled_proportions": Two-sample test proportions (pooled variance) - "cmh": Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test stratified binary data
code: # Part 1: Basic hypothesis definition kable(config$hypotheses[,c("type", "endpoint", "strata", "control", "test")],       caption = "Hypotheses - Part 1: Basic Definition") # Part 2: Analysis assignments analyses_info <- data.frame(   endpoint = config$hypotheses$endpoint,   analyses_analysed = sapply(config$hypotheses$analyses_analysed,                              function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", ")) ) kable(analyses_info, caption = "Hypotheses - Part 2: Analysis Assignments") # Part 3: Spending function details spending_info <- config$hypotheses %>%   select(endpoint, sf, sfpar, nominal) %>%   mutate(     sfpar = sapply(sfpar, function(x) if(is.null(x)) "NULL" else as.character(x)),     nominal = sapply(nominal, function(x) if(is.null(x)) "NULL" else paste(x, collapse=", "))   ) kable(spending_info, caption = "Hypotheses - Part 3: Spending Functions") # Part 4: Test method test_info <- config$hypotheses %>%   select(endpoint, test_method) kable(test_info, caption = "Hypotheses - Part 4: Test Methods") # Show which analyses test each hypothesis for(i in seq_len(nrow(config$hypotheses))) {   cat("Hypothesis", i, "(", config$hypotheses$endpoint[i], "):")   cat(" Analyses", paste(config$hypotheses$analyses_analysed[[i]], collapse = ", "), "\n") } #> Hypothesis 1 ( CR ): Analyses 1  #> Hypothesis 2 ( OS ): Analyses 1, 2, 3, 4  #> Hypothesis 3 ( EFS ): Analyses 1, 2, 3, 4

title: Configuration Guide for appendMCP
text: enroll_rate data frame specifies patient enrollment assumptions: Enrollment Rate Specification Column Definitions: stratum: Patient stratum identifier treatments: List treatment arms stratum rate: Enrollment rate (patients per month) stratum duration: Enrollment duration (months) stratum ratio: Randomization ratio vector treatment arms (e.g., c(1, 1) 1:1 randomization) Row Interpretation: - row represents enrollment one stratum - Total enrollment = rate × duration stratum - Treatments list shows arms patients stratum can randomized
code: kable(config$enroll_rate, caption = "Enrollment Rate Specification") # Calculate total enrollment total_enrollment <- sum(config$enroll_rate$rate * config$enroll_rate$duration) cat("Total Planned Enrollment:", total_enrollment, "patients\n") #> Total Planned Enrollment: 600 patients  # Show treatment allocation for(i in seq_len(nrow(config$enroll_rate))) {   cat("Stratum", config$enroll_rate$stratum[i], "treatments:")   cat(paste(config$enroll_rate$treatments[[i]], collapse = ", "), "\n") } #> Stratum Type_A treatments:PBO, TRT  #> Stratum Type_B treatments:PBO, TRT

title: Configuration Guide for appendMCP
text: distribution_tte data frame specifies parameters time--event endpoints: Time--Event Distribution Parameters Column Definitions: endpoint: Time--event endpoint name stratum: Patient stratum treatment: Treatment arm duration: Duration constant hazard period (Inf = constant throughout) fail_rate: Hazard rate (events per month) period dropout_rate: Dropout hazard rate (per month) Row Interpretation: - row defines hazard rates one stratum-treatment-endpoint combination - Multiple rows per combination allow piecewise constant hazards - Dropout assumed constant across periods Hazard Ratios OS Endpoint
code: kable(config$distribution_tte, caption = "Time-to-Event Distribution Parameters", digits = 4) # Calculate hazard ratios tte_summary <- config$distribution_tte %>%   filter(endpoint == "OS") %>%   select(stratum, treatment, fail_rate) %>%   tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = fail_rate) %>%   mutate(HR = TRT / PBO)  kable(tte_summary, caption = "Hazard Ratios for OS Endpoint", digits = 3)

title: Configuration Guide for appendMCP
text: distribution_bin data frame specifies binary endpoint parameters: Binary Endpoint Parameters Column Definitions: endpoint: Binary endpoint name stratum: Patient stratum treatment: Treatment arm rate: Response rate (probability success) maturity_time: Time (months) endpoint can evaluated Row Interpretation: - row defines response rate one stratum-treatment-endpoint combination - Maturity time determines patients contribute analysis - patients must followed least maturity_time months Treatment Effects Binary Endpoints
code: kable(config$distribution_bin, caption = "Binary Endpoint Parameters", digits = 3) # Calculate odds ratios bin_summary <- config$distribution_bin %>%   select(stratum, treatment, rate) %>%   tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = rate) %>%   mutate(     OR = (TRT / (1 - TRT)) / (PBO / (1 - PBO)),     Risk_Diff = TRT - PBO   )  kable(bin_summary, caption = "Treatment Effects for Binary Endpoints", digits = 3)

text: config Study configuration list 7 required components: **Study Metadata:** - `study_name`: Character string identifying study - `study_description`: Brief description study design - `alpha`: Overall Type error rate (typically 0.025 one-sided) **analyses:** Data frame defining analysis schedule. row specifies one planned analysis trigger conditions: - `endpoint`: Endpoint triggering analysis (e.g., "OS", "CR") - `strata`: List patient strata contributing trigger - `treatments`: List treatment arms contributing trigger - `sample_size`: Target sample size binary endpoints (NA TTE) - `events`: Target events time--event endpoints (NA binary) - `power_subsets_any`: Named list hypothesis subsets "least one rejection" power - `power_subsets_all`: Named list hypothesis subsets "rejections" power **hypotheses:** Data frame defining statistical hypotheses. row specifies one hypothesis: - `type`: "Primary" "Secondary" - `endpoint`: Endpoint tested - `strata`: List strata hypothesis - `control`: Control treatment arm name - `test`: Test treatment arm name - `analyses_analysed`: Vector analysis indices (analyses data frame) testing hypothesis - `sf`: Spending function ("none", "asHSD", "asOF", "asP", "asKD", "asUser") - `sfpar`: Spending function parameter (e.g., gamma HSD; NULL applicable) - `nominal`: Nominal alpha spending interims (optional; NULL spending function) - `test_method`: Statistical test ("logrank", "stratified_logrank", "unpooled_proportions", "pooled_proportions", "cmh") **enroll_rate:** Data frame specifying enrollment assumptions stratum: - `stratum`: Patient stratum identifier - `treatments`: List treatment arms stratum - `rate`: Enrollment rate (patients per month) - `duration`: Enrollment duration (months) - `ratio`: Randomization ratio vector (e.g., c(1,1) 1:1) **distribution_tte:** Data frame time--event distribution parameters: - `endpoint`: TTE endpoint name - `stratum`: Patient stratum - `treatment`: Treatment arm - `duration`: Duration constant hazard period (Inf = constant throughout) - `fail_rate`: Hazard rate (events per month) - `dropout_rate`: Dropout hazard rate (per month) **distribution_bin:** Data frame binary endpoint parameters: - `endpoint`: Binary endpoint name - `stratum`: Patient stratum - `treatment`: Treatment arm - `rate`: Response rate (probability success) - `maturity_time`: Time (months) endpoint can evaluated **graph:** Graphical multiple testing procedure specification: - `g`: Transition matrix (k×k k hypotheses). Element g[,j] = fraction alpha   hypothesis transferred j rejected. Diagonal = 0, row sums ≤ 1 - `w`: Initial weight vector (length k). Element w[] = initial alpha allocation   hypothesis . Sum must equal 1.0
